INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
